messages.subject: Statistics course online
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I have applied for a so-called MOOC fellowship <https://moocfellowship.org/> to
design an online course on statistical data analysis for the humanities
(specifically geared to linguistics and psycholinguistics, but also more
generally applicable).

This course will be a rewrite of some old lecture notes that have been
around for 10 years or so, see:

http://www.ling.uni-potsdam.de/~vasishth/book.html

I will be adding more detail on linear models and (generalized) linear
(mixed) models, so that people can go as deep as they want to.

The MOOC fellowship is an award of 25,000 Euros, and it seems they want
people to vote for courses. Of 250 courses, 10 will be funded.

My request is that if you find the idea of such a course interesting (for
you or for your students) please vote for me:

https://moocfellowship.org/submissions/statistical-data-analysis-for-the-humanities

Many thanks!

--
Shravan Vasishth
Professor für Psycholinguistik und Neurolinguistik
Department Linguistik
Universität Potsdam, D-14476 Potsdam
http://www.ling.uni-potsdam.de/~vasishth
